analysis: Within-case contrasts union-minus-inband, controlled-inband-minus-original, original-minus-no-gate; plant/predicate difference-of-differences; full nulls, exact input/motion equality, resolved/unresolved components. No p-values, prevalence or population generalization.
coverage_justification: Three ideal admissible archetypes cover long approach, radial offset/interior approach and holding; one outward boundary/velocity control is analytically unrecoverable. Three paired noisy two-filter midpoint contexts cover nominal packets, primary bias and dropout. Four arms crossed with two plants give 56 selected cases, plus six qualification continuations. No frequency or power interpretation.

qualification.unrecoverable_control_proof: At y=-27,vy=+.12, bounded acceleration yields y>-27 at sufficiently small positive time. Since every S point has y<=-27, no bounded input can preserve containment.

selection_prior_information: The existing midpoint failure and approximate exit are already known. Other cases are selected for causal coverage before observing their new outcomes. No replacement cases.
